details: The package's preinstall hook (node setup.mjs) is obfuscated. On install it detects the platform/architecture, downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime zip from github[.]com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip, extracts it, and executes a bundled 727KB obfuscated script (math_init.js) under that runtime. The install-time code path is deliberately obfuscated and executes an opaque obfuscated bundle, and the package declares dependencies on a large set of @or-sdk/* packages. The obfuscated install-time execution chain is consistent with a multi-stage dropper; the executed bundle's network behaviour could not be statically determined.
